capabilities: Render YAML struct definitions as SVG memory-layout diagrams
Auto-color fields and choose color schemes
Support C integer, float, array and padding types
extras: Screenshots referenced but not included in the extracted text; examples folder covers WAV headers, TCP/IP headers, ELF formats, Unix permissions, and CPU flag registers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw byte-level memory layouts of binary structures like file headers or protocol fields.
summary: Renders YAML definitions of C structs and binary data as interactive SVG memory-layout diagrams with color-coded, byte-accurate fields.
